# Third-party code

These folders hold code written by other people that this repository needs.
Each is kept as it was received (apart from removing duplicate and
autosave files) and stays under its own licence or terms. If you redistribute
this repository, keep these notices.

| Folder | What it is | Original author(s) | Licence / terms |
|---|---|---|---|
| `IsomapR1` | Isomap, release 1 (pure-MATLAB Floyd version is used, no compilation needed) | Josh Tenenbaum; Dijkstra code by Mark Steyvers | Copyright notice in `Readme`; cite Tenenbaum et al., Science 2000 |
| `zhuo_sim_defocus_2011` | `sparseBilateralFilter.m`, `getLaplacian.m` (matting Laplacian adapted from Levin et al.) | Shaojie Zhuo, Terence Sim | **Academic use only**; cite Zhuo & Sim, Pattern Recognition 2011 (see `README.txt`) |
| `guided_filter_boxfilter` | `boxfilter.m`, O(1) box filter from the guided filter code | Kaiming He et al. | as distributed by the authors |
| `colgrad_dizenzo` | `colgrad.m`, Di Zenzo multi-channel gradient | unknown (MATLAB File Exchange) | see file header |
| `(utils) Load_Spec.m` | ENVI loader | Jie Liang | included with attribution |
